name: Raffaella Bichiri
bio: Hello, I’m Raffaella, a multidisciplinary creative, photographer, and content strategist based in London.

Originally from Italy, I spent nearly a decade in Hong Kong before relocating to the UK. My career began in creative direction and brand experiences, where I worked across events, styling, and marketing for international fashion and lifestyle brands. This foundation shaped my approach to storytelling and visual communication.

Over time, my focus evolved toward photography and content creation, leading me to collaborate with clients including The Langham London, Zuma Hong Kong, and Michelin-starred restaurants such as Duddell’s, Ecriture, and Louise.

I bring together design thinking, image-making, and strategy to create concepts that connect aesthetics with purpose. I hold a BA in Fashion & Textile Design from NABA Milan and am currently completing an MA in Styling, Creative Direction & Digital Content at Istituto Marangoni London (2025–2026).
